1. Registration in Kerala: The seller/bidder must have a registered office in the S tate of Kerala. The bidder shall submit a valid Kerala Government Registration C ertificate or other applicable statutory registration/permission issued by the co mpetent authority, authorising the bidder to carry out the relevant business acti vities in Kerala. The certificate must be valid as on the date of bid submission. 2. Renewal of Registration Certificate: In case the validity of the submitted regis tration certificate has expired, the bidder must submit the latest renewed certifi cate. Where renewal is pending, valid documentary proof of renewal issued by t he competent authority shall be furnished, subject to applicable rules 4. Mandatory PSARA Licence: The bidder must possess a valid licence under the Private Security Agencies ( Regulation) Act, 2005 (PSARA), issued by the competent Licensing Authority, Government of Kerala, autho rising the agency to provide private security services in the jurisdiction covering Ernakulam District, Kerala . The bidder shall upload a self-attested copy of the valid PSARA licence along with the bid. The licence must be valid as on the date of bid submission and shall remain valid throughout the contract period. 5. Renewal of PSARA Licence: In case the existing PSARA licence has expired, the bidder must submit the d uly renewed licence issued by the competent authority. Mere submission of an application for renewal shal l not be treated as a substitute for a valid licence. 6. Verification: The Buyer reserves the right to verify the authenticity and validity of the PSARA licence with the concerned Licensing Authority. Bids submitted without a valid PSARA licence covering the required ge ographical jurisdiction shall be liable for rejection. Statutory reference: Sections 4, 7 and 8 of the Private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act, 2005. Important: Ensure that the licence covers Ernakulam District or the whole State of Kerala, as applicable. .
